headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2025: Guevara & Rhodes was no more, reborn as The Sons of Texas after 2 matches, on Collision.
Flash back to 2023, when Roderick Strong vs. Chris Jericho fought it out in a Falls Count Anywhere match on Dynamite, rated 8.24 ? a fantastic contest.
That Friday in 2024, Brian Cage vs. Anthony Bowens locked horns for the first time, topping the bill that night on Rampage, rated 5.73.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2025, after 3 matches, Roppongi Vice debuted a bold new identity: RPG Vice, on Collision.
On a Wednesday in 2023, back when Allin & Cassidy made their AEW debut as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.98.
2023 brought us this moment: Jack Perry vs. Rush locked horns for the first time on Dynamite, rated 7.31 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
